    Subclasses of AItem in edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.item
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    class 
    AMapItem
    Abstract base class for map-native items whose geometry is stored in geographic coordinates (longitude/latitude in radians) rather than in the container's affine-transform world coordinate system.
    class 
    AMapMultiPointItem
    Abstract base for map-native items whose geometry is an ordered array of geographic vertices (longitude/latitude in radians).
    class 
    MapLineItem
    A map-native line item defined by two geographic endpoints and rendered as a seam-aware great-circle route.
    class 
    MapMilSymbolItem
    Map-native military symbol item.
    class 
    MapPointItem
    A map-native point item whose location is stored as a geographic coordinate (longitude/latitude in radians) rather than a world-space point.
    class 
    MapPolygonItem
    A map-native closed spherical polygon defined by an ordered array of geographic vertices, with every edge (including the closing edge from the last vertex back to the first) rendered as a great-circle arc.
    class 
    MapPolylineItem
    A map-native open polyline defined by an ordered array of geographic vertices, with each consecutive segment rendered as a great-circle arc.
    class 
    MapTextItem
    A map-native text label whose anchor is stored as a geographic coordinate (longitude/latitude in radians).
